object.description: Change DOC-1's description from another program and activate the Document Editor, so that the banner shows. Choose Reload from disk. Expected: the banner is hidden and the grid shows the new description. Add an attribute to DOC from outside and reload. Expected: the grid has a column for it. Change DOC-1 again, activate, and choose Reload on the banner. Expected: the banner is hidden.
